recognize_zh: 骨髓切片骨小樑增粗、交錯吻合（osteosclerosis），小樑間正常造血消失，被纖維化基質與成巢的淡染空泡狀細胞取代，這種造骨性反應加上骨髓被取代，提示轉移性前列腺癌。
features: Thickened, irregular anastomosing bony trabeculae consistent with osteoblastic (osteosclerotic) reaction
Intertrabecular marrow replaced by desmoplastic fibrous stroma
Nests and sheets of pale, clear to vacuolated cells with small nuclei
Loss of normal hematopoietic elements and fat
Carcinoma cytologic detail limited at this low magnification
describe_en: Bone marrow trephine biopsy at low power shows thickened, anastomosing bony trabeculae indicating an osteosclerotic reaction. The intertrabecular spaces are replaced by fibrous stroma containing nests of pale, vacuolated cells, with loss of normal hematopoiesis and fat. Cytologic detail is limited at this magnification. Findings are suggestive of metastatic carcinoma with osteoblastic response, in keeping with prostatic origin; confirmation with pan-keratin, PSA and NKX3.1 immunostains is recommended.

ddx.vs: PMF shows clustered atypical megakaryocytes within fibrotic marrow and no keratin-positive epithelial nests.
Breast carcinoma can also be osteoblastic but is GATA3/ER positive and PSA/NKX3.1 negative.
Foamy histiocytes are CD68/CD163 positive and keratin negative, without a desmoplastic cohesive nested pattern.
